description: The plot, titled "SST-2, dirty-label, poison_num: 16", illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) across various trigger words for three different methods. The x-axis is categorical and lacks a general axis label, instead displaying a sequence of ten specific text tokens angled for readability: "bb", "mb", "cf", "beautiful", "excellent", "gorgeous", "wonderful", "brilliant", "stunning", and "beautifully". The y-axis represents the "ASR" on a linear scale, with visible numeric tick marks ranging from 0.2 to 0.8 at regular intervals of 0.2. The plot contains three solid lines distinguished by color and marker shape. The green line with dot markers, whose legend label is obscured by a gray rectangle, begins at approximately 0.73 for "bb", drops sharply to a low of 0.16 at "mb", and then generally increases, experiencing a steep rise to 0.80 at "beautiful" before climbing steadily to end at a peak of approximately 0.94 at "beautifully". The orange line with 'x' markers, labeled "random", starts at roughly 0.12 at "bb", dips slightly to 0.09 at "mb", and then follows an upward trend, rising sharply to 0.62 at "beautiful" and continuing to climb until it peaks at approximately 0.93 at "stunning", before ending lower at 0.85 at "beautifully". The purple line with circle markers, labeled "end", starts at 0.40 at "bb", rises slightly to 0.43 at "mb", and then exhibits significant volatility; it spikes to 0.89 at "cf", drops to 0.62 at "beautiful", rises to 0.81 at "excellent", dips to 0.71 at "gorgeous", reaches its highest peak of 0.91 at "wonderful", drops again to 0.82 at "brilliant", and finishes relatively steady at approximately 0.90 for both "stunning" and "beautifully".
